title: Feature-gate hub.rs `test_retention_gc_accessible` for default-features builds
objective: hub.rs test `test_retention_gc_accessible` and its set/get_retention_period calls reference the `#[cfg(feature = "retention")]`-gated `crate::retention` module, but the test fn itself is NOT feature-gated. Under DEFAULT features `cargo test -p prompt-hub` and `cargo clippy -p prompt-hub --all-targets` fail with E0432 unresolved import `crate::retention`. Distinct from PHTASK-0028 (argon2 OsRng, done). Pre-existing; uncaught because CI's default-build job builds the library only (no --tests) and the test/clippy jobs use --all-features. Found cycle 88 verifying PHTASK-0038. Fix (NO-DOWNGRADE): gate the test fn behind `#[cfg(feature = "retention")]` so default-features test compilation succeeds — wire the test to its feature, never delete it.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo test -p prompt-hub` (default features) compiles and runs
the retention test still compiles and runs under --all-features
source: discovered during cycle 88 verification of PHTASK-0038
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only. Here the fix WIRES the test to its existing feature gate; it does not delete the test.
